summary: Iter146 — Hair Colour Try-On (public catalogue + pick + admin views + branded poster + bell notice) and Veo narrated validation + resume 404 + avatar 422 all verified. 13/13 backend pytest pass. Frontend mobile flow: intro→skip→12 cards (all AI images load 200)→pick rose-brown→6-char code screen with the correct AI photo. Camera flow does NOT crash in Playwright's headless Chromium (fake media stream advances to camera step; Skip inside camera step goes to results cleanly). Admin Settings (behind Owner PIN 4321) shows color-tryon-card with color-poster-download (verified PNG download event → colour-tryon-miracurl-marathahalli.png), color-tryon-open link, color-picks-list containing both QA Guest and QA Browser picks. /book/miracurl-marathahalli still returns 200. Test seed data cleaned up (2 color_picks, 2 tenant_notices deleted).

issues: In real browsers with no camera the getUserMedia() rejection triggers color-cam-error inline, but Playwright's headless Chromium ships a synthetic fake video track so the error path is unreachable from automated tests. Not a product bug — only a testing-visibility note: the skip button inside the camera step still works and completes the flow cleanly, and no console errors were seen.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/hair_colors.py public_color_catalog: kicks off asyncio.create_task(_paint_missing()) on every request when any image is null — fine now (all 12 exist) but if hair_color_images is wiped the first N public visitors will trigger duplicate paint fan-out. The _painting flag serialises tasks inside one worker but not across gunicorn workers; consider a Mongo advisory lock or 'painting_started_at' field.

backend/routes/hair_colors.py public_color_pick: `notify_tenant(..., link='/pos', ...)` — landing color picks in POS is nice but the bell also opens on /settings; consider deep-linking to /settings#color-tryon-card so the stylist can view the AI photo & shade.

backend/routes/hair_colors.py ColorPickIn.undertone/depth pattern allows empty strings (good for on-device skip), but Pydantic 422 returned for 'hot' — correct. Name/phone have max_length but no min or sanitising; a spam pick with 80-char emoji name will be surfaced to the salon bell. Consider a rate-limit per slug or per IP on /public/color/{slug}/pick.

frontend/src/pages/ColorTryOn.jsx analyseSkin: pixel filter `R>60 && R>G && G>B*0.9` is a simple skin-tone heuristic — on very dark or very light backgrounds it may pick up background pixels. Consider adding a face-detection pass (FaceDetector API where available) before sampling, or reject if the sampled RGB has < 100 samples pointing to background.

frontend/src/pages/ColorTryOn.jsx: startCamera catches ANY getUserMedia error into the same 'Camera not available' string — NotAllowedError vs NotFoundError should give different UX (permission vs no hardware).

frontend/src/components/settings/ColorTryOnCard.jsx: uses localStorage.getItem('miracurl_tenant') for the /color/{slug} link — if the admin opens the card before tenant context loads slug will be empty and the link will go to /color/. Prefer reading from AuthContext / useTenant().

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all tested flows (public intro→skip→12 cards→pick→code; camera step + Skip → results with no crash; admin PIN unlock → color-tryon-card + download + picks list; /book regression 200)

rca_of_the_issue: No product bugs found. One environmental note: Playwright's built-in fake media stream shadows the getUserMedia rejection path, so tests must either (a) accept that camera step is entered successfully in headless, or (b) launch Chromium with `--use-fake-device-for-media-stream` combined with `--use-file-for-fake-video-capture=` pointing to a non-existent file to force a NotFoundError.
